out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT FOR EMPLOYEES TO READ AND SIGN.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH COPIES OF THE PROCEDURE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. PAPER TOWELS WERE NOT PROVIDED FOR THE HAND SINK AT THE ENTRANCE OF KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS PROMPTED THE CFM TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURES OF HAND SINKS AT ENTRANCE OF KITCHEN AND PREP AREA WERE 92F AND 80F, RESPECTIVELY.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINKS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: CUPS FOR BLENDERS WERE RINSED AT PREP SINK AND STACKED FOR USE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: (1) ORGANIC MILK (49F) WAS STORED IN TEA DISPENSER FOR ABOUT 4 HOURS; (2) COCONUT MILK (66F) WAS STORED IN AVANTCO 2-DOOR PREP COOLER FOR ABOUT 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF TEA DISPENSER AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. THPC WILL BE APPLIED FOR MILK STORED IN THE UNIT.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK AT 91F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A LONG HOSE WITH SPRAY NOZZLE WAS ATTACHED ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the UNISEX RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed the employees washing hands and turning off faucet with clean hands and air drying hands.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. Please note: you can provide faucet that does not need manually turn on or off, or provide a paper towel at the hand sinks.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at front service (drink prep) handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. ADVISED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE HAND SOAP AT THE FRONT SERVICE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at FRONT SERVICE (DRINK PREP) handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. ADVISED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWEL AT THE HAND SINK AT THE FRONT SERVICE DURING INSPECTION. HEY TEA (Inspection Date: 03/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE PRINT THE HAND WASHING SIGNAGE FROM THE FOLLOWING LINK AND POST IT AT ALL HAND WASHING SINKS: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/health/sites/health/files/Assets/documents/PDF/handwashing-flyer.pdf

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: 1) two Steam Water Boiler 2) Self dispensing team machine at the front service
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE PROVIDE CERTIFICATION FOR BOTH ITEMS (NSF, ETL SANITATION, OR UL SANITATION LISTED) WITHIN 90 DAYS.

violations.title: Modification to Section 4-205.10 Equipment Certification
violations.observation: The following items are intended for household use only and are not approved for use in a commercial food establishment: TWO HAND MIXTURES
violations.corrective_action: Food equipment that is certified or classified for sanitation by an American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited certification program will be deemed to comply with Parts 4-1 and 4-2 of this chapter. Food equipment in a food establishment shall be certified of classified by an ANSI-accredited certification program, an equivalent certification program, or approved by the Regulatory Authority before installation and/or use. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO PROVIDE ANSI STANDARD EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED HOT WATER AT 108F
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PROVIDE HOT WATER AT MINIMUM OF 110F AT THE 3-VAT SINK.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system CONNECTED TO BOTH STEAM WATER BOILER AT THE FRONT SERVICE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PROVIDE BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE BOTH STEAM WATER BOILER WITHIN 72 HOURS.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @ THE MOP SINK is not observed. OBSERVED THE SPRAY HOSE CONNECTED.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO KEEP THE SPRAY HOSE DISCONNECTED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE PITCHER RINSER AREA FLOOR WITH POOLING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO TRAIN EMPLOYEES ON PROPER WAY TO RINSE AND STORE THE PITCHERS TO PREVENT WATER POOLING ON THE FLOOR. ALSO, ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO INCREASE CLEANING/MOPING FREQUENCY AT THE SERVICE AREA TO PREVENT WATER POOLING ON THE FLOOR.
